arxiv-1812-00470.title: Diffractive gauge boson production at the LHC as a probe of the flavour content of the Pomeron
arxiv-1812-00470.creator: E. A. F. Basso 1 , V. P. Goncalves 2 , D. E. Martins 3 , M. S. Rangel 3
arxiv-1812-00470.description: Abstract The production of the W W and Z Z bosons in single diffractive processes at the LHC is investigated taking into account the ATLAS, CMS and LHCb acceptances and considering different assumptions for the flavour content of the Pomeron.

arxiv-2012-02352.title: Algorithms for Contractibility of Compressed Curves on 3-Manifold Boundaries
arxiv-2012-02352.creator: Erin Wolf Chambers, Francis Lazarus, Arnaud de Mesmay, Salman Parsa
arxiv-2012-02352.description: Abstract In this paper we prove that the problem of deciding contractibility of an arbitrary closed curve on the boundary of a 3-manifold is in NP . We emphasize that the manifold and the curve are both inputs to the problem. Moreover, our algorithm also works if the curve is given as a compressed word.

arxiv-2111-03519.title: S-MULTI-SNE: Semi-Supervised Classification and Visualisation of Multi-View Data
arxiv-2111-03519.creator: Theodoulos Rodosthenous, Vahid Shahrezaei, Marina Evangelou
arxiv-2111-03519.description: Abstract An increasing number of multi-view data are being published by studies in several fields. This type of data corresponds to multiple data-views, each representing a different aspect of the same set of samples. We have recently proposed multi-SNE, an extension of t-SNE, that produces a single visualisation of multi-view data.

arxiv-2207-08772.title: Josephson Diode Effect in High Mobility InSb Nanoflags
arxiv-2207-08772.creator: Bianca Turini, Sedighe Salimian, Matteo Carrega, Andrea Iorio, Elia Strambini, Francesco Giazotto, Valentina Zannier, Lucia Sorba, Stefan Heun
arxiv-2207-08772.description: Abstract We report evidence of non–reciprocal dissipation–less transport in single ballistic InSb nanoflag Josephson junctions, owing to a strong spin–orbit coupling. Applying an in–plane magnetic field, we observe an inequality in supercurrent for the two opposite current propagation directions. This demonstrates that these devices can work as Josephson diodes, with dissipation–less current flowing in only one direction.

arxiv-2301-00195.title: Sub-Planck structures and sensitivity of the superposed photon-added or photon-subtracted squeezed-vacuum states
arxiv-2301-00195.creator: Naeem Akhtar, Jizhou Wu, Jia-Xin Peng, Wu-Ming Liu, Gao Xianlong
arxiv-2301-00195.description: Abstract The Wigner function of the compass state (a superposition of four coherent states) develops phase-space structures of dimension much less than the Planck scale ℏ \hbar , which are crucial in determining the sensitivity of these states to phase-space displacements.

arxiv-2303-06973.title: Catalog of noninteracting tight-binding models with two energy bands in one dimension
arxiv-2303-06973.creator: Edward McCann
arxiv-2303-06973.description: Abstract We classify Hermitian tight-binding models describing noninteracting electrons on a one-dimensional periodic lattice with two energy bands. To do this, we write a generalized Rice-Mele model with two orbitals per unit cell, including all possible complex-valued long-range hoppings consistent with Hermicity.

arxiv-2308-03599.title: Frustration relief and reorientation transition in the kagome-like dolerophanite Cu 2 OSO 4
arxiv-2308-03599.creator: Amelia Panther, Alexander A. Tsirlin, Ioannis Rousochatzakis
arxiv-2308-03599.description: Abstract We present a theoretical study of dolerophanite Cu 2 OSO 4 , a layered kagome-like spin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} magnetic insulator that can be described either as a system of chains coupled through dimers or as a kagome lattice where every third spin is replaced by a ferromagnetic spin dimer.

arxiv-2311-02846.title: Solvable limit of ETH matrix model for double-scaled SYK
arxiv-2311-02846.creator: Kazumi Okuyama, and Takao Suyama
arxiv-2311-02846.description: Abstract We study the two-matrix model for double-scaled SYK model, called ETH matrix model introduced by Jafferis et al [arXiv:2209.02131]. If we set the parameters q A , q B q_{A},q_{B} of this model to zero, the potential of this two-matrix model is given by the Gaussian terms and the q q -commutator squared interaction.

arxiv-2406-07396.title: Impact of the nuclear equation of state on the formation of twin stars
arxiv-2406-07396.creator: Nai-Bo Zhang and Bao-An Li
arxiv-2406-07396.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nai-Bo Zhang and Bao-An Li. Twin stars-two stable neutron stars (NSs) with the same mass but different radii have long been proposed to appear as a consequence of a possible first-order phase transition in NS matter. Within a meta-model for the EOS of hybrid stars, we revisit the viability of twin stars and its dependence on numerous parameters characterizing the EOS of nuclear matter, quark matter, and the phase transition between them.

arxiv-2408-09006.title: Context-aware Code Summary Generation
arxiv-2408-09006.creator: Chia-Yi Su, Aakash Bansal, Yu Huang, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Collin McMillan
arxiv-2408-09006.description: Abstract . Code summary generation is the task of writing natural language descriptions of a section of source code. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI-based technologies have helped make automatic code summarization a reality. However, the summaries these approaches write tend to focus on a narrow area of code.

arxiv-2509-00188.title: On the stability of Ricci flow on hyperbolic 3-manifolds of finite volume
arxiv-2509-00188.creator: Ruojing Jiang, Franco Vargas Pallete
arxiv-2509-00188.description: Abstract . On a hyperbolic 3-manifold of finite volume, we prove that if the initial metric is sufficiently close to the hyperbolic metric h 0 h_{0} , then the normalized Ricci-DeTurck flow exists for all time and converges exponentially fast to h 0 h_{0} in a weighted Hölder norm.

arxiv-2512-14457.title: An Improved Approximation Algorithm for Maximum Weight 3-Path Packing
arxiv-2512-14457.creator: Jingyang Zhao, Mingyu Xiao
arxiv-2512-14457.description: Abstract Given a complete graph with n n vertices and non-negative edge weights, where n n is divisible by 3, the maximum weight 3-path packing problem is to find a set of n / 3 n/3 vertex-disjoint 3-paths such that the total weight of the 3-paths in the packing is maximized.

arxiv-2602-06788.title: Displacement-Resistant Extensions of DPO with Nonconvex f f -Divergences
arxiv-2602-06788.creator: Idan Pipano, Shoham Sabach, Kavosh Asadi, Mohammad Ghavamzadeh
arxiv-2602-06788.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Idan Pipano, Shoham Sabach, Kavosh Asadi, Mohammad Ghavamzadeh. DPO and related algorithms align language models by directly optimizing the RLHF objective: find a policy that maximizes the Bradley-Terry reward while staying close to a reference policy through a KL divergence penalty. Previous work showed that this approach could be further generalized: the original problem remains tractable even if the KL divergence is replaced by a family of f f -divergence with a convex generating function f f .

pmc-11372628.title: Opercular myoclonic-anarthric status (OMASE) secondary to anti-Hu paraneoplastic neurological syndrome
pmc-11372628.creator: César Romero, Alonso Quijada, Gabriel Abudinén, Catherine Céspedes, Ledda Aguilera
pmc-11372628.description: Highlights•OMASE is an uncommon presentation of focal motor status epilepticus.•OMASE presents as dysarthria and myoclonus involving the glossopharyngeal muscles.•OMASE causes include vascular, tumor, drugs, infections, and autoimmune diseases.•OMASE associated with anti-Hu antibodies partially responds to medical therapy.•Significant improvement in symptoms was obtained after tumor resection.

pmc-11409241.title: Outcome measures used in adolescent sport-related concussion research: a scoping review
pmc-11409241.creator: Connor Shane McKee, Chris Bleakley, Alan Rankin, Mark Matthews
pmc-11409241.description: ABSTRACTObjectivesTo provide an overview of the outcome measures currently used after sports-related concussion (SRC) in adolescents, categorising by the constructs they assess, follow-up duration and their feasibility of use.DesignScoping review.Data sourcesWe searched three electronic databases (MEDLINE, EMBASE and CINAHL). We also undertook citation tracking of the included articles and searched for ongoing or unpublished trials using ClinicalTrials.gov and Theses Global.

pmc-11433756.title: Impact of Microplastic Exposure on Blood Glucose Levels and Gut Microbiota: Differential Effects under Normal or High-Fat Diet Conditions
pmc-11433756.creator: Manjin Xu, Huixia Niu, Lizhi Wu, Mingluan Xing, Zhe Mo, Zhijian Chen, Xueqing Li, Xiaoming Lou
pmc-11433756.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Microplastics are emerging pollutants that have garnered significant attention, with evidence suggesting their association with the pathogenesis of type 2 diabetes mellitus. In order to assess the impact of polystyrene microplastic exposure on alterations in the gut microbiota and the subsequent implications for glucose dysregulation under different dietary conditions in mice, we investigated the effects and disparities in the blood glucose levels induced by polystyrene microplastic exposure in mice fed a high-fat diet versus those fed a normal diet.

pmc-11504362.description: Blue light accelerates retinal aging. Previous studies have indicated that wavelengths between 400 and 455 nm are most harmful to aging retinal pigment epithelia (RPE). This study explored whether filtering these wavelengths can protect cells exposed to broad sunlight. Primary porcine RPE cells loaded with 20 µM A2E were exposed to emulated sunlight filtered through eye media at 1.

pmc-11658429.title: Identification of dimethyl 2,2’-((methylenebis(2-(2H-benzo[d][1,2,3]triazol-2-yl)-4-(2,4,4-trimethylpentan-2-yl)-6,1phenylene))bis(oxy))diacetate (TAJ4) as antagonist of NEK-Family: a future for potential drug discovery
pmc-11658429.creator: Mubashir Aziz, Syeda Abida Ejaz, Pervaiz Ali Channar, Ali G Alkhathami, Tahir Qadri, Zahid Hussain, Mumtaz Hussaain, Rabail Ujan
pmc-11658429.description: The purpose of the current study was to analyze and validate the existing gap in knowledge, by conducting a differential expression analysis and validation of NEK6, NEK7, and NEK9 in breast, cervical, and glioblastoma cancer and targeting these proteins through development of novel site specific inhibitor with favorable pharmacokinetic and safety profile, using open-source databases.

pmc-12651216.title: Utility of REMS-Derived Fragility Score and Trabecular Bone Score in Evaluating Bone Health in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-12651216.creator: Antonella Al Refaie, Caterina Mondillo, Guido Cavati, Sara Gonnelli, Maria Dea Tomai Pitinca, Elena Ceccarelli, Paola Pisani, Luigi Gennari, Stefano Gonnelli, Carla Caffarelli
pmc-12651216.description: Background/Objectives: A significantly higher fracture risk characterizes Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) patients when compared to the non-diabetic population, even though their average bone mineral density (BMD) tends to be normal or high. This elevated risk is primarily driven by defective bone quality.

pmc-12766194.title: Do ethnic disparities exist in disease burden and healthcare utilization of male breast cancer? A 9-year cohort study of 9.08 million adults in China
pmc-12766194.creator: Jieying Chen, Liying Qiao, Ying Yan, Meng Qi, Yunjing Zhang, Weiwei Kang, Huziwei Zhou, Yuelin Yu, Yalei Ke, Yuling Jiang, Yingting Rao, Lu Xu, Guohua He, Jing Ren, Xue Yan, Siwei Deng, Xinyu Yang, Yutong Song, Yingzi Yang, Qiaorui Wen, Jing Han, Yiwei Wu, Guozhen Liu, Mingyuan Wang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Y
pmc-12766194.description: BackgroundAs a rare disease, male breast cancer (MBC) is of increasing concern in China. Whether health inequalities of disease burden and healthcare utilization exist by ethnicity in male breast cancer remains unclear. We aim to measure disease burden and healthcare utilization by ethnicity among male breast cancer patients in China.

pmc-13177766.title: Spatial variation of healthcare resource use in Wales following the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-13177766.creator: Timothy Osborne, Rowena Bailey, Amy Mizen, Richard Fry
pmc-13177766.description: , and identify socio-demographic and environmental factors associated with the geographical differences. We accessed and linked individual electronic healthcare records within the Secure Anonymised Information Linkage (SAIL) Databank. We calculated age-sex standardised rates of interactions across 1909 small areas in Wales, from January 2017 to December 2022.

pmc-13245573.title: Advancing Cardiovascular Health in Delaware Through Community Partnerships
pmc-13245573.creator: Athena Klapak
pmc-13245573.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). that prioritize access, practical skills, and local engagement. Together, these initiatives reflect a community-centered approach designed to meet people where they are and reduce barriers to heart health. Practical Nutrition Education That Meets People Where They Are

Behavioral risk factors are central to cardiovascular health, yet the gap between knowing what to do and being able to do it can be wide. Time constraints, cost, and limited access to hands-on education often make healthy choices feel out of reach.

pmc-13286987.title: MST4 plays dual roles in lung adenocarcinoma by regulating homeostasis of wild-type and mutant p53 protein
pmc-13286987.creator: Minghui Zhang, Changwei Hu, Huilong Liu, Chenxi Zhang, Qipeng Shu, Yu-Jian Kang, Yuetian Ding, Jin Zhang, Zhenghui Hu, Haokai Wang, Youfan Zhang, Ze-Yan Zhang, Shangze Li
pmc-13286987.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mutations are highly prevalent in the TP53 tumor suppressor gene, which encodes p53, in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). However, targeted therapies centered on p53 mutations remain challenging. Here, we found MST4 highly expressed in LUAD and linked to patient survival. Functional assays using CRISPR-generated MST4-knockout LUAD cell lines revealed context-dependent dual roles of MST4: tumor-suppressive in wild-type p53 (wtp53) cells (inhibiting proliferation, colony formation, migration) and oncogenic in gain-of-function (GOF) p53 cells.

pmc-13332190.title: Respiratory health impacts of coal-fired power plant emissions with transboundary environmental complexities
pmc-13332190.creator: Shyamasree Dasgupta, C R Parvathy, Raja Dhar, Sayantan Sarkar, Megha Anand, Akash Sharma, Yingchang You, Shiguo Jia, Rausan Zamir, Mohammad Shoeb, Apostolos Bossios, Joyanto Routh
pmc-13332190.description: This interdisciplinary longitudinal study examines the association between PM2.5 levels at sites downwind of a coal-fired thermal power plant (TPP) near the India-Bangladesh border and respiratory health in the exposed population, assessed using spirometry and fractional exhaled nitric oxide levels.

pmc-13372662.title: Distinct ATRX functions cooperate with 9-1-1 and CST complexes to safeguard replication and telomere integrity
pmc-13372662.creator: Sandra Segura-Bayona, Marija Maric, Tohru Takaki, Zornitsa Manova, Tyler H Stanage, Aurora I Idilli, Shudong Li, Graeme Hewitt, Feras E Machour, Rhona Millar, Marek Adamowicz, Ronnie Ren Jie Low, Phil Ruis, Benura Azeroglu, Todd Fallesen, Harshil Patel, Steven Howell, Panagiotis Kotsantis, Michael H
pmc-13372662.description: Mutations in the ATRX chromatin remodeler confer a predisposition to a developmental genetic disorder and cancer, but how ATRX safeguards genome and telomere stability remains unresolved. Here, we uncover critical dependencies for the CTC1–STN1–TEN1 (CST) complex and RAD9A–HUS1–RAD1 (9-1-1) clamp in ATRX-deficient cells.

pmc-13483054.title: Experimental evaluation of fly ash and lime stabilization on the geotechnical characteristics of expansive clay for road subbase applications
pmc-13483054.creator: Nnadi Ezekiel, Josephine Najjibyo, Deepa Krishnan, Emmanuel Izere
pmc-13483054.description: Expansive clay soils pose significant challenges in road construction due to their high plasticity, swelling potential, and low bearing capacity. This study investigates the combined use of fly ash, lime, and waste tyre granules as sustainable stabilizing agents, addressing a gap in existing research. Laboratory tests were conducted to assess the geotechnical properties of treated and untreated soils.
